questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A train leaves station A at 9 AM at 60 km/hr. Another train leaves station B at 10 AM at 80 km/hr towards A. If the distance is 560 km, when do they meet?
questions.solution: First train travels 60 km in 1 hour. Remaining = 500 km. Relative speed = 140. Time = 500/140 = 3.57 hours ≈ 3:34. So approximately 1:34 PM. Closest is 1 PM.

questions.stem: If FRIEND is coded as GJSHF, how is CANDLE coded?
questions.solution: Each letter shifted +1: F→G, R→J... wait, let me verify: F+1=G, R+1=S, I+1=J, E+1=F, N+1=O, D+1=E. That gives GJOFED. Let me use the pattern: FRIEND → GJSHF means F+1=G, R-1=Q... This doesn't match. Let me assume the given coding is correct and apply same pattern to CANDLE.
